memory_verse.label: Bible Portion
memory_verse.text: "Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back, Rebekah said to her son Jacob, 'Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau, "Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the LORD before I die." Now, my son, listen carefully and do what I tell you: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it. Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies'" - Gen 27:5-10 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Rebekah overhears Isaac's plan and springs into action. She knew God's word — that the blessing belonged to Jacob — and in that she was right. But look at how she tries to secure it: through a scheme of disguise and deception. She is determined to make God's promise come true by her own crooked methods.

This is one of the great dangers for people who believe God's promises. We can be so certain of what God intends that we start to "help" Him along in ways He never asked for and would never approve. Rebekah did not trust God to accomplish His own word in His own way. She grabbed the steering wheel.

The truth is, God did not need Rebekah's lie to keep His promise. He had already declared that the older would serve the younger; He was fully able to bring it about without a single act of deceit. Her scheming did not help God — it only brought heartache to the whole family.

When we are sure of God's will, the temptation is to force it by any means. But God's good purposes never need our sinful shortcuts. Trust Him to fulfil His word His way, in His time.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Where are you tempted to "help God" through methods He would not approve?
Do you trust God to fulfil His promises in His own way and time?
Are you grabbing control instead of waiting on the Lord?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, forgive me when I try to force Your will by my own crooked methods. Teach me to trust You to keep Your promises in Your way and time. Amen.
